entry.title: Hello from Wirepost
entry.summary: The first post on a feed that is nothing but static files.
entry.content:
This post is a signed, content-addressed object. So is every other post in this feed, and so is the record saying which posts exist.

Nothing here needs a server. The whole publication is a folder of files:

  • every post is addressed by the hash of its own contents

  • the feed's identity is a hash, not a domain name

  • moving hosts does not change what the feed is

A verified badge means this came from this identity. It never means this is true.

You can follow this feed in a Wirepost reader, or subscribe with the Atom link below in any ordinary feed reader.
